metadata.title: NetApp.ONTAP
metadata.description: NetApp.ONTAP PowerShell Toolkit. The ONTAP 9.19.1 PowerShell Toolkit provides end-to-end automation and enables more efficient and scalable administration of NetApp storage. This module contains over 2340 PowerShell cmdlets to help you automate ONTAP administration on FAS and AFF systems, commodity hardware, and the cloud. This toolkit also supports REST API with 9.10 and later version of ONTAP. The toolkit also provides cross-platform support for Windows, Ubuntu, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), and macOS.
